text:
nina: quick mock drop -- on first-run we added a tiny banner nudge under header: "Pick a sample to launch a demo app" with a subtle chevron to reveal the sample tray. questions: is the nudge discoverable enough? is the chevron affordance clear?

pranav: On desktop the nudge is fine but on mobile it competes with the top hero. Maybe make it sticky to the bottom on small screens?

maya: I worry sticky bottom + keyboard could obscure content. Maybe make it sticky only after users scroll past hero.

design-bot: A/B note: variant A shows the nudge inline under hero, variant B pins it to bottom on scroll. Track click-throughs `onboard.sample_nudge_cta` per variant.

eli-a11y: Chevron must have aria-hidden if decorative and the reveal button should have aria-expanded + aria-controls. add `role=button` and keyboard handlers.

nina: For copy options: 1) "Pick a sample to launch a demo app" 2) "Try a sample demo with prefilled prompts" 3) "Start with an example project" Which feels clearest?

pranav: Option 1 is fine but change "launch" -> "spin up"? feels casual. maybe keep "launch" for clarity.

maya: Option 3 is explicit  for newcomers. I vote for 3.

eli-a11y: Also ensure nudge has 3:1 minimum size for touch target and visible focus. If hiding on initial load, make sure screenreader users can still access via a link in header.

nina: Plan: pick option 3 copy, keep inline for desktop, sticky on scroll for mobile variant, implement aria-expanded on reveal, and add analytics. I'll update frames and post.

pranav: I'll prototype sticky-on-scroll behavior in Framer and share.

maya: I'll run a quick guerilla test with 3 folks and report back.
